title.narrative: GA 2025- Jandar Power Supply in Conflict Affected

description.narrative: Access to electricity in Syria has been severely impacted by 15 years of crisis. There is an urgent need to secure reliable electricity for essential services and to support the restoration of livelihoods and accelerate economic recovery. The project aims to enhance recovery and enable sustainable development, strengthened public service delivery, and improved living conditions for millions of people in Syria through the provision of reliable and sustainable electricity. The project will focus on the maintenance of the Jandar Power Plant, not only to stabilize the electricity supply but also to improve operational efficiency, reduce downtime, and lower maintenance costs, ultimately strengthening the overall energy supply system and laying the groundwork for sustainable recovery across sectors. This project will benefit 1,843,720 people with more reliable and efficient generation of electricity.
